_comment: Magneettipaja (games/magneetti): the magnet game's clips; the Finnish ones are in voice/fi.json.

clips.mag_l1: Pull the nails into the box with the magnet. Keep your finger on the screen and the magnet pulls.
clips.mag_l1_opit: A magnet pulls iron and steel.
clips.mag_l2: Which things stick to the magnet? Take them to the box.
clips.mag_l2_opit: Iron and steel stick. Wood, plastic, glass and gold do not stick to a magnet.
clips.mag_l3: Take the ball to the hole. The magnet pulls from under the board. Go slowly, or the ball stays behind.
clips.mag_l3_opit: A magnet's force goes through wood.
clips.mag_l4: Push the red magnet into the hole without touching it. Your magnet stays in the lower part.
clips.mag_l4_opit: Poles of the same colour push each other away. Different colours pull each other.
clips.mag_l5: Turn the bar magnet into place. Red end on red, blue end on blue.
clips.mag_l5_opit: Every magnet has two poles, a red one and a blue one.
clips.mag_l6: Take the ball to the goal. Magnets fixed on the board pull the ball. Keep it away from them.
clips.mag_l6_opit: Iron sticks to both poles, red and blue.
clips.mag_ei_tartu: This does not stick to a magnet.
clips.mag_kaikki: All tasks done! You are a magnet master!
